name: The Falcon Inn

layers.essential_history: [[c:Fotheringhay is a tiny village with a huge history. In the 1500s it was described as a single street of around 40 houses.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:The village once had a weekly market and an annual fair, and its population peaked at about 310 in 1811.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:The night before the royal burial, a page runs into the inn: the white rose has gone from the church. He drops a note in his hurry.]]

puzzle.title: [[c:The page's note]]
puzzle.intro: [[c:Each letter has been moved one place along the alphabet. Move each one back a place.]]
puzzle.question: [[c:Where did the page last see the rose? (one word)]]
hints: [[c:It's the building with the tall tower.]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:It says CHURCH. The rose was last seen in the church.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:Stuck? Take a hint: hints are free.]]

evidence: [[c:The rose was last seen in the church.]]
support: [[c:Support the village: the Falcon is the village pub.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Walk west along Woodnewton Road for about 70 metres and take the footpath on the right, heading north across the fields for about 450 metres to the brook. Turn right along the brook path to the Nassington road, then turn right and walk back down into the village to the church. About 1.4 km.]]
